acp-runtime.original_pending: The original decision result is unconfirmed. Check the same operation without selecting another option again.
acp-runtime.intent_unavailable: The original submission cannot be verified. Actions are paused; keep the record and retry reading.
acp-runtime.access_denied: You can no longer view or decide these requests. Check your current project access.
acp-runtime.background_paused: Automatic reads are paused. Refresh manually to check the latest requests.
acp-runtime.permission_scope: Each decision applies only to this request in the node's current attempt. The process remains active and retains its execution slot while waiting.
acp-runtime.no_permissions: No permission requests have been saved for this node yet.
acp-runtime.incomplete_details: The request details are incomplete. Approval is unavailable; you can still reject this request.
acp-runtime.decision_boundary: Saving a decision does not establish that the runner has read it or the provider has applied it. It grants no lasting permission.
acp-runtime.invalid_read: Permission data does not match the current execution source. Check it again.
acp-runtime.refresh_failed: Current permission requests could not be read. The original decision and conflict are retained.
acp-runtime.setup_intro: A local administrator fixes the executable, reviewed version and model before registration from an actual inventory observation.
acp-runtime.setup_executable: Absolute path to the native executable
acp-runtime.setup_version_hint: Enter the complete --version output from this executable; it must match the actual observation.
acp-runtime.setup_credential_hint: Enter only a local environment variable name, never a secret; leave blank to use the existing CLI login.
acp-runtime.setup_invalid: Complete the valid path, version, model and optional credential reference before copying.
acp-runtime.setup_policy: This CLI is a trusted local process, not an operating-system sandbox. A model-selection acknowledgement does not prove the provider's underlying model, and observed usage does not enforce a hard budget.
acp-runtime.setup_register: Read actual tool inventory, register paused, then explicitly enable. Configuration alone does not establish execution readiness.
acp-runtime.setup_no_scan: Qoder is not included in automatic local discovery. Have the Runner load the fixed configuration and report actual inventory; absence from discovery does not mean it is not installed.
acp-runtime.facts.title: ACP execution facts
acp-runtime.facts.host_stopped_after_rpc: The protocol operation completed before the tool process and its descendants were stopped.
acp-runtime.facts.configured_boundary: The administrator fixes the model configuration.
acp-runtime.facts.identity_boundary: Selection acknowledgement confirms configuration only, not the provider's actual model.
acp-runtime.facts.budget_boundary: Usage is observed; provider spending is not capped by this integration.
acp-runtime.facts.invalid_evidence: Execution evidence does not match the fixed configuration and needs checking.
acp-runtime.facts.no_evidence: No evidence for this execution yet.
acp-runtime.facts.delivery_boundary: Turn completion, code candidates, independent tests and human acceptance are verified separately.
